Configuration Specialization Capstone Requirement Along with passing the course exam, you must also successfully complete the capstone in order to fulfill all the requirements of your certification. The capstone consists of multiple exercises. This workbook organizes th e tasks in those exercises . Use this workbook to help you keep track of your progress. Some tasks must be completed in order to complete your capstone; others are not required but are recommended. You will know which tasks are required or optional when you see th e following formatting : This exercise task is required for your capstone. ο This exercise task is optional /recommended. Purpose of Capstone The capstone is the culmination of the educational program — the finish line! It gives you an opportunity to evaluate your ability to apply the concepts that you’ve learned. It also gives you the opportunity to configure a realistic instance— as you would configure for an actual Buyer Organization. Completing Your Capstone You will use an instance provided by JAGGAER to complete your capstone. Once you subm it your capstone, the instructor will confirm that you’ve configured a functional , realistic site. Your site must include the following:
• Master Data (Units of Measure, Currencies) & Category Tree
• User Management – Users, User Roles, Divisions, Division Managers
• Types, Fields, & Forms – Basic [segreto] Form & RFQ Form
• Program Management Workflow – Workflow with Parent and Child tasks
• Approval Matrix – RFQ Awarding Approval Matrix with Approvers

• Datamart – Stand Reports & Report Profile Submitting Your Capston e Once you’ve completed the capstone , please email Ashley Kochis ([email]) to officially “submit ” your capstone . Please be sure to include the following information in the email:
• Your instance ’s URL
• Your Administrator credentials (username and password)
